name: Crow-Crowned Geas Breaker
lore: A Hollow entity that broke the sacred geas binding the Celtic land. It wears a crown of void-mist crow shapes and holds a broken spear — the weapon that was meant to defend the land, now turned against it. Broken ogham stones orbit it, each one a broken promise.
visualDescription: 50-60ft Hollow entity in corrupted Celtic garb with broken torc. Crown of void-mist crow shapes. Broken spear. Floating broken ogham stones. Gate stone in chest. Sacred grove corrupted.
mapBehavior: Boss encounter — 3 phases: spear attacks, crow summon, ogham stone barrage
